claims.claim: Apple reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16% year over year, with double-digit revenue growth across iPhone, Mac and Services and every geographic segment.

Apple reported gross margin of 50.1% and diluted EPS of $2.02, but explicitly attributed about 2 percentage points of gross margin and $0.11 of EPS to tariff refunds, so normalized execution should separate that temporary benefit.
Apple stated operating cash flow set a June-quarter record and its installed base of active devices reached an all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.

risks.risk: Headline margin and EPS contain a quantified temporary tariff-refund tailwind and should not be treated as fully recurring operating improvement.

contradictions.contradiction: Record headline profitability coexists with a material temporary tariff-refund benefit; this qualifies, rather than falsifies, the strong consolidated execution signal.

unknowns.unknown: This source does not quantify incremental revenue or adoption attributable specifically to Siri AI.
This evidence is source acquisition only; Alpha retains authority for numeric underwriting, score risk and data-confidence construction.
